div.div: Private center path: network hub -> transit -> application and object_storage interface endpoints (S3). Ground station 10.4x.2.10 in Soporte uses application (CC-DRN-01) and object_storage (CC-DRN-03). drone_object_ingress and telemetry_ingress tiers are RESERVED (ASM-140, CC-DRN-02).

div.div: Drone inference path: persisted mission record -> EventBridge Pipe + bus -> one SQS queue per function -> Lambda -> Amazon Bedrock in us-east-1. Retries and DLQs are defined in A17 (PD-111 closed).

div.div: TLS 1.2+ in transit; encrypted device buffers; KMS encryption at rest. Five-year retention for telemetry, drone objects, flight records and sack history. Objects containing a person are excluded from inference (PD-015 closed). Inference results record timestamp, confidence and source-object ID; no trigger authorizes fumigation.

div.div:
Farm: encrypted store-and-forward to public IoT Core. Center: firewall -> IPsec hub -> pdn allow-listed private endpoints. Drone: pre-signed S3 upload from center or municipal seat. Transport + port: public application API.
2020 retained: farm telemetry, alerts and sack traceability. Retired: assumed farm coverage, direct device-to-ingestion publishing and mobile-generation dependence; vessel tracking is out of scope.

div.div: Mode boundary: `crop_alert_raised` enters precision mode; `focus_confirmed` makes an order eligible but never authorizes it. Polygon + closed confirmation record are required before order release. Verification cannot close a case if object or inference is missing.
